body.statement: Using \(\mathfrak H_{\mathrm{frontier}}\), determine explicit rate functions \(\rho_{\mathrm{est}}(N,K)\) and \(\rho_{\mathrm{len}}(N,K)\) such that \(R_d(N,K)\asymp\rho_{\mathrm{est}}(N,K)\) and \(E_{d,\alpha}(N,K)\asymp\rho_{\mathrm{len}}(N,K)\) uniformly over every legal \(K=K_N\), including exact fixed-\(K\) logarithms and every transition. The lower-bound branch must choose the finite-support simultaneous family so that \(\Delta_{N,K}\) matches the claimed rate, \(\operatorname{TV}_{\mathrm{mix}}\le1/4\), and \(\mathfrak g_{\mathrm{rem}}\ge0\) certifies the endpoint separation against every rematching column; its ordered low-versus-high version must also support the one-sided length converse. The upper-bound branch must construct a computable estimator and uniformly honest lower bound attaining the respective rates, or prove a sharper shared-geometric dual bound if the simultaneous family cannot achieve the required separation.
body.justification: The theorem-level kernel is the exact all-arm estimation and honest-length frontier, not merely another plug-in bound.
body.gap: Gao--Ge--Qian stop at minimax optimality for \(d\le4\); Manole--Niles-Weed leave logarithmic slack for two margins; no closer source found in the 2026 search subsumes the arbitrary-margin endpoint problem.
body.consumer: The frontier gives a principled uncertainty deduction for every empirical multiworld second-moment lower endpoint, including the scholarship-incentive audit.
